message: 19.5-pip iH&S armed ~70% up the pattern: the pcl-exhausted abort (too-high, a fib level at 1.14328) sits only 3.9 pips under TP and fires INTRABAR, so a single 03:00Z wick (high 1.14358, close 1.1429) retires the plan ~32h before expiry. All six cells abort on that same wick. This cell: skip-BCR enters 00:00Z @1.14172, i.e. the setup WAS tradeable — it's the BCR gating that was too slow, not the geometry. [rev-off twin: same setup armed with --skip-reversals, so no 06/07 close rule is present.]
